purpose_context: Since #256 every DocKitty PlantUML render runs sandboxed and remote includes fail the build. Some sites legitimately need a shared remote stdlib or style include and today can only get it by silently hand-editing the documented service setup. This mission adds one explicit, loud, verifiable operator opt-in (narrow allowlist first, full internet only as a second explicit value) without changing anything for sites that do not opt in. Consumer: spec-kitty/spec-kitty#6100 and #6916.
purpose_tldr: Let a site operator deliberately allow PlantUML diagrams to fetch named remote includes, while the hardened sandbox stays the default.
